contract.question: How do recorded fixed and learned strength-control warps alter identical test inputs?
contract.claim: The plate makes image changes and spatial difference patterns inspectable under one common rendering scale.

panels.a: First non-target test image and its five strength-control transforms plus clean input.
panels.b: Second non-target test image under the same transforms.

contract.sample_selection: First two test-set indices with label != 0, fixed before rendering; no ASR or image-quality selection.
contract.unit: Two illustrative inputs from one recorded seed block (42), not independent training repetitions.
contract.precision: Exact saved float32 initialization; learned seeds read from six-decimal CSV, no extra renormalization.
contract.transform: Same 0.5/32 bicubic warp, align_corners=True, clipped grid, bilinear sampling; raw [0,1] RGB intensities.
contract.difference: min(10*mean_channels(abs(warp-clean)),1); one magma color scale [0,1] over all difference cells.
contract.exports: 159.2 x 119 mm, Arial, editable 7.2-pt labels in SVG/PDF, embedded 32x32 raster images, PNG and 1000-dpi TIFF.
contract.scope: These reconstructions are separate from the 9,000-pair random-warp quality comparison; no predictions or ASR inferred.

rounding: Only exported PNGs use nearest-integer 8-bit RGB; figure and NPZ use float32 inputs.
retained_control_identity: Original Free seed-42 run, final ASR 90.00%; not the instrumented 97.07% repeat.
